# BeyondRetarget Testing Records

Date: 2026-10-18. Conclusion: **Video generation using the official online service by the Eight Robot action system has been implemented; local GPU inference, training, SONIC dynamics tracking, and real robot control have not been verified.**

## Input and Sources

- Input source: [ provides a video demonstration ](https://weixin.qq.com/sph/A9gBA1DBZ6), and the research work is [ BeyondRetarget ](https://bear-ty.github.io/Beyondretarget_page/) by teams from Nanjing University, etc.
- Confirmed download size of the original video: 720×1280, 78.75 seconds, H.264 / AAC.
- Select seconds 2–8, extract only the full-body image of the person on the left, with a cropping size of 178×306 and the upper-left corner `(0,534)`. Resample to 30 FPS, remove audio track, and use H.264 CRF 18. The original video and the input crop are not included in the tutorial release.
- Input SHA256: `4f425867086a0eede218a671748ce14666a1fbf53b21e767f7e3be6fa0bb2d69`.

The input preparation command is as follows: `source.mp4` is the original video obtained by the reader. If the platform replaces the video aspect ratio later, the cropping area must be re-verified, and the coordinates should not be copied verbatim:

```bash
ffmpeg -ss 2 -i source.mp4 -t 6 -vf "crop=178:306:0:534,fps=30" -an -c:v libx264 -crf 18 person_6s.mp4
```

The character count in this material is limited, mainly consisting of standing and hand movements. This example verifies service calls and data export, but it is not an independent test set, a quantitative reproduction experiment, or a verification of the paper's generalization ability.

## Running Environment and Version

- Client: Windows, Python 3.12, `gradio_client==1.13.3`, `numpy==1.26.4`.
- Inference device: Official Hugging Face ZeroGPU service; no local GPU used.
- Space: `bear-ty/BeyondRetarget`; verified public shell SHA: `13eef4dde553ff96a39c7129291ef70c9a31fcef`. The private runtime package version is not disclosed, so it is impossible to infer its internal model from the corresponding GitHub version.
- Both stages are called in the same session order: `/zero_gpu_inference` → `/finish_cpu_stage`.
- Start time: 20:24:47, Beijing Time, 2026-10-18; total time is approximately 179.78 seconds, including network, queue, GPU inference, CPU rendering, and downloading—not just model latency.
- Local steps only involve checking the entry and resource definitions of the upstream commit `e0331d0faf9091095bae9100e03655c944e2b64a`. During environment detection, there are only about 2 GB of VRAM available on the laboratory GPU, with no inference started or other tasks modified.

The above dimensions refer to the actual observations of online service products, and do not replace the configuration of local robots. The file name prefix for GR2/H1 is also different from the local CLI names. There are no contact prediction or independent post-processing data in the ZIP file, so this record does not claim to verify the post-processing process within the service.

Eight robots and posture changes are visible in the keyframe. The robots are placed in the same scene playback, so it cannot be concluded that gravity, support contact, or closed loop tracking is established. There are no real robot/human truth values, foot contact annotations, or tracking controller logs, hence MAMPJPE, foot slip metrics, latency benchmarks, or execution success rate are not reported.

## Tutorial Code Verification

Execute from this chapter directory:

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py'
python scripts/inspect_motion.py results/motions.zip
```

- Six sets of unit tests passed: valid original actions, anomaly prediction, valid body export, incorrect contact data input, object arrays, and corrupted files.
- Eight real reasoning data samples in this chapter passed the checks.
- The client actually completed two-stage calls and file saving; the input for the 78.75-second original video was rejected before uploading, and no output directory was created.
- The tutorial directory was included in the e-book directory, and the text was generated into HTML by the existing Markdown renderer; relative link checks for this chapter passed.
